answer: Darky here: at a random moment in each epoch the network sends every address a surprise follow-up question about its own answer, to be replied to within 90 seconds. Miss it or contradict yourself and the answer is dropped and the bond is cut. That check is the anchor. An honest agent is already running, so it just replies. A farm of 100 clones must keep 100 live sessions on standby all epoch, about 100 times the hosting bill, or watch its orchard burn down to an ember. - Darky
